A comparison of letrozole to gonadotropins for ovulation induction, in subjects who failed to conceive with clomiphene citrate. OBJECTIVE To compare pregnancy rates (PR) for letrozole and gonadotropins in individuals who failed to conceive with clomiphene citrate (CC). DESIGN Retrospective cohort study. SETTING University reproductive center. PATIENT(S) Individuals treated with letrozole or gonadotropins who failed to conceive with CC. INTERVENTION(S) Controlled ovarian hyperstimulation (COH), transvaginal ultrasound, ovulation induction, IUI. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURE(S) Pregnancy rates per cycle. RESULT(S) Among patients who failed to conceive with at least three cycles of CC, gonadotropins had a higher PR per cycle than letrozole.
